Task Guide:


Task: Bulk Modulus of Magnesium
Description: Calculate the bulk modulus of magnesium by computing the full elastic stiffness tensor using finite deformation and stress analysis. Use the Embedded Atom Method (EAM) potential for magnesium. Apply small finite deformations in each of the six independent strain modes (ε₁ to ε₆ in Voigt notation: ε₁ = ε<sub>xx</sub>, ε₂ = ε<sub>yy</sub>, ε₃ = ε<sub>zz</sub>, ε₄ = 2ε<sub>yz</sub>, ε₅ = 2ε<sub>xz</sub>, ε₆ = 2ε<sub>xy</sub>), one at a time. From the resulting stress-strain data, compute the full 6×6 elastic stiffness matrix (C<sub>ij</sub>). Report the bulk modulus in GPa via Voigt averaging.

Required submission format:
numerical value without units (eg. 56.00)


Available input data:
All the potentials, can be found at /potentials/. Note that in case of reaxff potentials, pair style 'reax/c' has been renamed to 'reaxff' and always use NULL for the control file (cfile), for example, this syntax is correct : pair_style reaxff NULL.

- units: metal
- pbc: true
- minimiser: conjugate gradient
- energy_tolerance: 1e-10
- force_tolerance: 1e-10
- maximum_iterations: 100000.0
- maximum_evaluations: 100000.0
- materials_project_id: mp-153
- atom_style: atomic
- deformation_step_size: 1e-06
- total_deformation: -1 * (deformation_step_size * lattice parameter)

 Save all the files in /results/2_AUGUST_2025/claude_35/tool_calling/bulk_modulus/brief/tasks/magnesium_bulk_modulus_trial_1 when using tools use this path.

{"path": "/results/2_AUGUST_2025/claude_35/tool_calling/bulk_modulus/brief/tasks/magnesium_bulk_modulus_trial_1/elastic.in", "content": "# LAMMPS input script for elastic constants calculation

# Initialization
units metal
atom_style atomic
boundary p p p

# Read structure
read_data Mg.data

# EAM potential for Mg
pair_style eam/alloy
pair_coeff * * /potentials/Mg_Sun_JPC.eam.alloy Mg

# Energy minimization
minimize 1.0e-10 1.0e-10 100000 100000

# Set up elastic calculation
change_box all triclinic

# Store initial box dimensions
variable L0x equal lx
variable L0y equal ly
variable L0z equal lz

# Define strain increment (1e-6)
variable up equal 1.0e-6
variable down equal -${up}

# Output
thermo_style custom step temp pe press pxx pyy pzz pxy pxz pyz lx ly lz vol
thermo 1

# Elastic constants calculation

# C11
variable dir equal 1
variable delta equal ${up}
include /potentials/elastic_calc.mod

# C22
variable dir equal 2
variable delta equal ${up}
include /potentials/elastic_calc.mod

# C33
variable dir equal 3
variable delta equal ${up}
include /potentials/elastic_calc.mod

# C44
variable dir equal 4
variable delta equal ${up}
include /potentials/elastic_calc.mod

# C55
variable dir equal 5
variable delta equal ${up}
include /potentials/elastic_calc.mod

# C66
variable dir equal 6
variable delta equal ${up}
include /potentials/elastic_calc.mod

print "All elastic constant calculations completed""}

function.arguments:
{"path": "/results/2_AUGUST_2025/claude_35/tool_calling/bulk_modulus/brief/tasks/magnesium_bulk_modulus_trial_1/bulk_modulus.in", "content": "# LAMMPS input script for bulk modulus calculation

# Initialization
units metal
atom_style atomic
boundary p p p

# Read structure
read_data Mg.data

# EAM potential for Mg
pair_style eam/alloy
pair_coeff * * /potentials/Mg_Sun_JPC.eam.alloy Mg

# Energy minimization
minimize 1.0e-10 1.0e-10 100000 100000

# Output settings
thermo_style custom step temp pe press vol
thermo 1

# Store initial volume
variable V0 equal vol
variable P0 equal press

# Apply small strain
variable delta equal 1.0e-6
change_box all x scale $(1.0-${delta}) y scale $(1.0-${delta}) z scale $(1.0-${delta}) remap units box

# Minimize
minimize 1.0e-10 1.0e-10 100000 100000

# Get final pressure
variable P1 equal press
variable V1 equal vol

# Calculate bulk modulus
# B = -V(dP/dV) ≈ -V0(P1-P0)/(V1-V0)
variable bulk_modulus equal -${V0}*(${P1}-${P0})/(${V1}-${V0})/10000 # Convert to GPa

print "Bulk Modulus (GPa) = ${bulk_modulus}""}
